issue_context.title: remove `stmtctx` dependency from `tablecodec` and `rowcodec`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Just like what we have done in the `util/codec`, the dependency `stmtctx` can also be removed from `tablecodec` and `rowcodec`. It will make the logical dependency of these functions in `tablecodec` and `rowcodec` much clearer.

review_comments: I don't think we need `if sc != nil` because it is checked in `sc.HandleError`.

I personally hope every calls to the `sc.HandleError` can ensure that the `sc != nil`. I think as we continue on refractoring the stmt context, we can finally reach the goal, but not now.

The `if sc != nil` in `sc.HandleError` is there only to avoid panic in production. We also have a `intest.AssertNotNil(sc)` to assert it's not nil in tests. If `if sc != nil` here is removed, it'll panic in test. We have done similar things in `sc.TimeZone()`.
